title: Current Project: Vending Machine Restoration
description: Modernization of coffee vending machines through the development of a custom touchscreen interface, significantly enhancing usability and overall user experience. The system is currently deployed on three machines located in Radzionków, Mysłowice, and Siemianowice Śląskie.The project is actively maintained and continuously improved, with ongoing work focused on introducing new features, refining the interface, and implementing a custom MDB (Multi-Drop Bus) communication system for better hardware integration and control.

title: Pomodoro App
description: A web application designed to support focused study using the Pomodoro technique, enhanced with ambient sound playback from YouTube. Built with React and Chakra UI, it features a customizable timer, local data storage, and a simple note-taking module.
